article:
Test 9
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Can dolphins talk?
Scientists know that dolphins are intelligent creatures. But now they are (21).................. whether the noises that dolphins make are actually a form of language.
Dolphins make various noises to communicate information to each other, about things like their location in the ocean. But scientists wanted to discover exactly how dolphins communicate when working together. So they recorded the noises that dolphins made while (22).................. a difficult exercise. The scientists had designed a box with ropes attached to either side. Inside the box were some fish. The box could be opened more (23).................. if two dolphins worked together — using the ropes to pull the box in opposite (24).................. to open it.
The dolphins made noises much more (25).................. while they were working together to (26).................. the problem. But does this mean that they were actually talking to each other? More research is needed before scientists can be sure.

[--- Table Start ---]
| 21 | A guessing | B wondering | C thinking | D believing |
| 22 | A completing | B reaching | C ending | D producing |
| 23 | A accurately | B properly | C easily | D correctly |
| 24 | A routes | B directions | C paths | D positions |
| 25 | A generally | B immediately | C usually | D frequently |
| 26 | A answer | B explain | C solve | D deal |
[--- Table End ---]

questions.explanation:
B. wondering
“wonder whether” 为固定搭配，意为 “想知道是否”，符合语境 “科学家正想知道海豚发出的声音是否真的是一种语言”。
A. guessing（猜测）、C. thinking（思考）、D. believing（相信）
拓展：“wonder” 后可接 “who/what/why/how” 等疑问词引导的从句，如 “wonder how they communicate”（想知道它们如何交流）。

A. completing
“complete a difficult exercise” 表示 “完成一项困难的任务”，符合 “科学家记录海豚完成任务时发出的声音” 的语境。
B. reaching（到达）、C. ending（结束）、D. producing（产生）
拓展：“complete” 强调 “圆满完成某事”，名词形式为 “completion”，如 “the completion of the task”（任务的完成）。

C. easily
根据后文 “两只海豚合作拉绳子” 可知，合作能让箱子更 “容易” 被打开，“easily” 表示 “容易地”，符合逻辑。
A. accurately（准确地）、B. properly（恰当地）、D. correctly（正确地）。
拓展：“easily” 可修饰动词，表示动作的难易程度，如 “solve the problem easily”（轻松解决问题）。

B. directions
“in opposite directions” 为固定短语，意为 “朝相反的方向”，指两只海豚向不同方向拉绳子才能打开箱子。
A. routes（路线）、C. paths（路径）、D. positions（位置）均不与 “in opposite” 搭配。
拓展：“direction” 常见搭配：“in the direction of”（朝…… 方向）、“change direction”（改变方向）。

D. frequently
“more frequently” 表示 “更频繁地”，指海豚合作时发出声音的频率更高，符合 “科学家研究交流方式” 的语境。
A. generally（通常）、B. immediately（立即）、C. usually（通常）。
拓展：“frequently” 副词，意为 “频繁地”，形容词为 “frequent”，如 “frequent meetings”（频繁的会议）。

C. solve
“solve the problem” 为固定搭配，意为 “解决问题”，此处指海豚合作打开箱子（解决难题）。
answer（回答）后多接 “问题（question）”，而非 “problem”；B. explain（解释）、D. deal（处理）需搭配介词 “with”（deal with）。
拓展：“solve” 侧重 “找到问题的解决方案”，名词为 “solution”，如 “a solution to the problem”。
